name: Source evaluation
description: Weighs how far a source can be trusted: who wrote it, when, and what it rests on.
body:
## When it applies

A step that leans on outside material: weigh each source before using it.

## Checks

- **Who** wrote it, and what they gain from it.
- **When** it was written, and whether it was revised.
- **What it rests on**: primary data, other sources, or opinion.

| Kind | Trust |
| --- | --- |
| Primary data | high |
| Review article | medium |
| Opinion piece | low |
